rule: Refuse session (SeamError) after N consecutive cells that hit max_new_tokens with zero decodable tool-call steps, counted across both arms.

observed.signature: exact 512-token burns; empty tool-call decode; both arms

why_n_equals_3: Exceeds one dual-arm entry pair (2 cells), so a single entry under per-entry dual-arm scheduling cannot alone trip the guard.
Matches the earliest multi-entry streak in b1a291f0 (base_1/4B, base_2/4B, base_2/8B) — would abort before the remaining ~39 garbage cells.
Distinct from ordinary BFCL emission noise (Q-KV failures are short EOS / no tools, not unbroken 512-cap burns).
